chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad ibn Humran, from Zurara, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The women do not inherit from the land, nor from the realty, anything.
ai.seo_question: Do women inherit from land and real estate according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) clarifies that women are excluded from inhering specifically from immovable property (al-arḍ and al-ʿiqār), a ruling often interpreted by Shia jurists as referring to land held in trust or specific contexts distinct from general movable assets. This distinction highlights the nuanced application of inheritance laws within Shia fiqh, differentiating between types of wealth while maintaining the broader Quranic framework of female inheritance.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Humran, from Zurara, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The women (widows) do not inherit from the land, nor from the realty (property/estate), anything’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Muhammad ibn Humran from Zurarah from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Women do not inherit from land and real property anything.’”
